description:
A boy afraid of closeness after deep loss finds himself drawn to a quiet painter who hides the same wounds. Through photography and shared silence, he dares to open up—because for once, he's found someone worth the risk.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/5261000121), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/colour-of-you), [Lalatoon](https://www.lalatoon.com/kr/webtoon/episode/toon/8602), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/colorofyou), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000077073)
